sentences.en: He likes spicy food, in contrast, she prefers mild flavors.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢吃辣的食物，相比之下，她更喜欢清淡的口味。

sentences.en: The city is bustling and busy, in contrast, the countryside is peaceful and quiet.
sentences.zh: 这座城市喧闹繁忙，相比之下，乡下地方则安静而祥和。

sentences.en: She was always punctual for meetings, in contrast, her colleague often arrived late.
sentences.zh: 她开会总是准时到达，相比之下，她的同事常常迟到。
